prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A 34-year-old woman in an oatmeal knitted sweater pauses beside a modest decorated New Year tree, holding a plain ceramic mug and looking toward someone outside the frame with a warm smile. Soft gold lights and understated ornaments add a festive backdrop. Use an intimate candid portrait with window daylight balanced by warm tree lights. Output a vertical 4:5 composition for a website cover. Keep the lower 20 percent visually quiet for an optional website caption; place no faces, hands, or key gestures there. Preserve generous space above and beside the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct casting: a fictional fair-skinned red-haired woman with a wavy chin-length bob, light freckles, and an ordinary fuller face. Native aspect ratio EXACTLY 4:5, vertical.
review: Vertical portrait shows a freckled red-haired woman beside a lit tree and window. Both hands naturally hold the mug; face, fingers and sweater texture look coherent. Full head has margin and lower area is quiet.
